seoDescription: Your space is already deciding how you live. Book a free Intro Call, or a one hour Design Kick-off, with Petrina Salema in Vienna.
hook: Your space is already deciding how you live. Stop decorating around a life you didn't choose. Actively shape the room that holds how you want to rest, gather, and think.

projectOffer.title: Full project
projectOffer.body: A redesign of how a home or room operates. Considering how a family or guests move through the space, layout and material, improving layout and material choices, then sourcing and styling.
projectOffer.note: I take on a few residences a year. Most take one to three months, working in-person in Vienna, and remotely abroad.
projectOffer.finance: I provide a quote after the initial Intro Call. A deposit is requested at the start of the project, then you are billed in stages up to the final stage. Do a first call for €290 and get clarity on what to do with your space.

jumpstartOffer.title: Design Kick-off
jumpstartOffer.body: Spend one hour discussing the plan. We identify the changes that would have the biggest impact. You leave with a clear next step.

quote.text: My daughter started calling her room the room from the fairy tale.
